source: This matters because “one FLOP” is not a useful performance currency across all operation types. Tensor cores can execute matrix multiply-accumulate at enormous throughput, while exponentials, scalar reductions, conversions, and shared-memory synchronization have different limits.
zh: 这很重要，因为“一次 FLOP”并不是适用于所有操作类型的有用性能货币。张量核可以以巨大的吞吐量执行矩阵乘法累加，而指数、标量缩减、转换和共享内存同步则有不同的限制。
